definitions.de: Felswand, Klippe, steiler Fels; kann je nach Kontext auch ein bestimmtes Stück Stoff oder Tuch bedeuten
definitions.en: Cliff, rocky face, steep rock; in some contexts can also refer to a piece of cloth or fabric
definitions.es: Acantilado, pared rocosa, roca escarpada; en algunos contextos también puede referirse a una tela o tejido
definitions.fr: Falaise, paroi rocheuse, roche escarpée; dans certains contextes peut aussi désigner un morceau de tissu
definitions.hi: चट्टान, खड़ी चट्टान; कुछ संदर्भों में कपड़े या वस्त्र के टुकड़े को भी संदर्भित कर सकता है
definitions.ja: 崖、断崖、岩壁；文脈によっては布や生地を指すこともある
definitions.km: របាំង​ថ្ម, ចំណោត; ក្នុងបរិបទខ្លះ ក៏អាចមានន័យថាកំណាត់ក្រណាត់ ឬក្រណាត់
definitions.ko: 절벽, 암벽, 가파른 바위; 문맥에 따라 천 조각을 의미하기도 함
definitions.ne: चट्टान, भिरालो शिला, खडेरी चट्टान; केही सन्दर्भमा कपडाको टुक्रा पनि बुझाउँछ
definitions.pt: Falésia, paredão rochoso, rocha íngreme; em alguns contextos também pode se referir a um pedaço de tecido
definitions.th: ผา, หน้าผา, หินชัน; ในบางบริบทอาจหมายถึงผืนผ้าหรือผ้าผืนหนึ่งด้วย
definitions.tl: Bangin, pader ng bato, matarik na bato; sa ilang konteksto maaari ring tumukoy sa piraso ng tela
definitions.ur: چٹان، کھڑی چٹان، پہاڑی دیوار؛ بعض سیاق و سباق میں کپڑے کے ٹکڑے کے لیے بھی استعمال
definitions.vi: Vách đá, vách núi dựng đứng; trong một số ngữ cảnh cũng có thể chỉ một mảnh vải
definitions.zh: 悬崖，峭壁，岩壁；在某些语境中也可以指一块布料
definitions.zh_Hant: 懸崖，峭壁，岩壁；在某些語境中也可以指一塊布料

definition_en: Cliff, rocky face, steep rock; in some contexts can also refer to a piece of cloth or fabric

lao_examples.lao_script: ຜາສູງນັ້ນສວຍງາມຫຼາຍ ຢາກໄປຖ່າຍຮູບ
lao_examples.romanization: pha sung nan suay ngam lai, yak pai thai hup
lao_examples.translation_en: That tall cliff is so beautiful – I want to go take photos there.

lao_examples.lao_script: ລະວັງໆ ຢ່າຍ່າງໃກ້ຜາ ອັນຕະລາຍ
lao_examples.romanization: la wang la wang, ya yang kai pha, an ta lai
lao_examples.translation_en: Careful, careful – don't walk near the cliff, it's dangerous.
